authorNotes.finding: The public READ BEFORE YOU USE bio permits commercial/personal use without a permission request. Credit and donations are optional; the contributor asks users not to send permission DMs.

The bio rejects uploading/distributing the unchanged track on music/social distribution services and describes supporting multimedia use. Its reassuring YouTube wording must not be treated as a guarantee against claims; the official FAQ describes possible claim effects.
